name: Contact
description: An organisation, or an engaged individual, that BD has a relationship with: its profile, address, tags and people.

global.schema:
type ContactState {
  name: String
  kind: ContactKind!
  status: ContactStatus!
  email: String
  phone: String
  website: String
  vatId: String
  registrationNumber: String
  address: PostalAddress!
  tags: [String!]!
  people: [ContactPerson!]!
  notes: String
}

type PostalAddress {
  street: String
  postalCode: String
  city: String
  country: String
}

type ContactPerson {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  role: String
  email: String
  phone: String
}

enum ContactKind {
  SUPPLIER
  CUSTOMER
  BOTH
  OTHER
}

enum ContactStatus {
  ACTIVE
  ARCHIVED
}

operations.name: SET_PROFILE
operations.schema:
input SetProfileInput {
  name: String
  kind: ContactKind
  email: String
  phone: String
  website: String
  vatId: String
  registrationNumber: String
  notes: String
}

operations.name: SET_ADDRESS
ADD_TAG
REMOVE_TAG
ADD_PERSON
operations.schema:
input AddPersonInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  role: String
  email: String
  phone: String
}

operations.name: UPDATE_PERSON
operations.schema:
input UpdatePersonInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String
  role: String
  email: String
  phone: String
}

operations.name: REMOVE_PERSON
ARCHIVE_CONTACT

errors.name: StatusUnchangedError
errors.description: The contact already has that status
